Synonyms

Examples

Mobile

,

What is a tooltip component?

Tooltips display informative text labels that provide contextual support, usually on hover, but sometimes on click or tap.

When used effectively, tooltips can significantly improve user experience by providing timely, relevant information without cluttering the main interface.
